zh: 可以用 ChatGPT 计划登录了：设置 › 模型与密钥 › OpenAI › 「通过 ChatGPT 继续」（官方登录或 Codex 登录二选一），用你的 Go / Plus / Pro / Business 额度运行 OpenAI 模型，不需要 API Key
开发任务做出网页、本地 HTML 或 Web 服务后，Bot 会自动在内置浏览器里打开；画面类结果会先截图自查、有明显错位先修好再交给你
模型单次输出有上限时，Bot 会把大文件拆成几段写，不再反复失败
Bot 可以在配对的执行端（另一台电脑或服务器）上工作：提议换到执行端文件夹、在那台机器上跑命令；修复了配对后一直离线、Windows 执行端启动失败、macOS 托盘不显示等问题
新话题统一显示问候页，建议跟着界面语言走；「执行 / 只规划」和工作文件夹放在同一行
连接 › 技能：写技能统一从右上角「添加」进入；时间统一 24 小时制；侧栏标签不再被截断
Anthropic 里说明了 Claude 订阅怎么用：Max / Team 等计划附带的 API 额度可以用 Console 的 API Key 接入
更新改为增量下载：只下载变化的部分，更新页显示这一版的更新内容
外部 Agent（Codex、Claude Code、Cursor、OpenCode）可以作为 Bot 加入：在 Pi Bot 的沙箱里运行，能用 Bot 浏览器、发文件、用连接和技能，审批卡和审计与 Pi Bot 的 Bot 一致；关于你的记忆默认不发，按 Bot 打开
例行任务可以交给外部 Agent 跑，Bot 也可以把一步工作委派给 Agent Bot 并拿回结果（新权限「交给外部 Agent」，默认询问）
Bot 浏览器更快更稳：打开网页不再等满所有资源，截图失败先重试；回复中途断线会接着写完，不再整轮失败；简单任务不再先建计划
沙箱更懂你的工作：连 adb、Docker、本地数据库等本机服务时问一次、按文件夹记住；依赖文件夹（node_modules、.venv 等）里的 .vscode / .bashrc 可以写；gh、aws、ssh 等直接请你批准在沙箱外运行；工作位置外的缓存路径批准一次后记住
手机连电脑默认允许打洞直连，不在同一网络也能直连；电脑关着时手机能用自己的模型继续聊，回来后自动同步
MCP 和插件可以「从来源更新」并逐项对比改了什么；启动失败时说明原因（缺依赖、沙箱拦截等）
切换对话更快；模型设置页会标出默认模型为什么不能用；后台任务失败的卡片可以忽略，原因说人话
编辑器通过 ACP 连接时，可以切换 Bot 的模型、思考强度和全局默认模型
执行端托盘在执行端没响应时也能退出；用户指南新增「自建中继」和「在编辑器里用 Pi Bot」两章
en: Sign in with your ChatGPT plan: Models & keys › OpenAI › Continue with ChatGPT (official or Codex sign-in) runs OpenAI models on your Go / Plus / Pro / Business allowance, no API key needed

When a development task produces a web page, local HTML or a web service, the Bot opens it in its built-in browser; visual results get a screenshot self-check, and obvious layout errors are fixed before hand-off
When a model can only output so much at once, Bots write large files in parts instead of failing repeatedly

Bots can work on a paired runner (another computer or server): they propose moving to a runner folder and run commands there. Fixed runners staying offline after pairing, the Windows runner failing to start and the macOS tray not appearing
Every new topic opens on the greeting page with suggestions in the interface language; Execute / Plan only and the working folder share one row
Connections › Skills: writing a skill starts from the top-right Add menu; times use the 24-hour clock; sidebar tabs are no longer cut off
Anthropic explains how to use a Claude plan: the API credit included with plans such as Max or Team works through a Console API key
Updates download only what changed, and the update page shows what each version changes

External agents (Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, OpenCode) can join as Bots: they run in Pi Bot's sandbox and use the Bot browser, file sending, connections and skills under the same approval cards and audit; memories about you are off by default, per Bot
Routines can run on an external agent, and a Bot can hand a step to an agent Bot and get the result back (new permission "Hand work to external agents", Ask by default)

The Bot browser is faster and steadier: pages no longer wait for every resource, a failed screenshot is retried; a reply cut off by a dropped connection continues instead of failing; small tasks no longer start with a plan

Sandbox: local services (adb, Docker, local databases) are asked about once and remembered per folder; .vscode / .bashrc inside node_modules, .venv and similar can be written; gh, aws, ssh go straight to a run-outside approval; approved outside cache paths are remembered
The phone connects to your computer through NAT by default, so it connects directly even on another network; when the computer is off the phone keeps chatting on its own model and syncs back later
MCP servers and plugins can be updated from their source with a per-item comparison; a failed start says why (missing dependency, sandbox block, ...)
Switching conversations is faster; the model settings show why the default model cannot be used; failing background-task cards can be dismissed and explain the reason plainly
Editors connected through ACP can switch the Bot's model, its thinking level and the app's default model
The runner tray can quit even when the runner stops responding; the user guide has new chapters on self-hosting the relay and using Pi Bot from your editor
